# 2025 Merrimack Warriors football team

The 2025 Merrimack Warriors football team will represent Merrimack College as an independent during the 2025 NCAA Division I FCS football season. The Warriors are expected to be led by second-year head coach Mike Gennetti and play home games at Duane Stadium in North Andover, Massachusetts.
